title: Think3D: Thinking with Space for Spatial Reasoning
abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D visual understanding, they remain constrained by 2D-centric paradigm that severely limits genuine 3D spatial reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce Think3D, a novel framework that equips VLM agents with interactive, 3D chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. By integrating a suite of 3D manipulation tools, Think3D transforms perception into active spatial exploration, mirroring human geometric reasoning. Think3D consistently improves proprietary models, including GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.5 Pro, across BLINK Multi-view, MindCube-1K, and VSI-Bench-Tiny. We further propose Think3D-RL to teach smaller open-weight models how to manipulate 3D space effectively. Using only final-answer rewards, without process supervision or handcrafted exploration trajectories, Think3D-RL enables Qwen3-VL-4B to autonomously learn effective 3D exploration strategies. After training, the model exhibits tool-use patterns similar to those of stronger proprietary models, while shifting the effect of 3D tool use on MindCube-1K from a performance drop to a substantial improvement. These results show that active exploration in 3D space provides an effective and general paradigm for improving spatial reasoning in multimodal agents. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/zhangzaibin/spagent.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2601.13029v5 的 32 页全文与关键图表核验整理。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。 本轮贡献归入VLM空间推理；3D Generation沿用原论文库的3D工具关联，不表示本版提出了新的3D生成方法。
analysis.ideaZh: Think3D v5 增补 learned-vs-random viewpoint 控制、完整tool/RL prompts，并按3:1:2重算MindCube整体准确率，纠正旧版比较。作者报告RL backbone随机视角45.11%、learned policy53.39%，支持学到有用观测选择；但RL训练只在八个候选角度、977样本和最多三轮内，不能说无任何prompt先验或任意自由3D exploration。
analysis.motivationZh: VLM面对多视图空间题时，直接在2D证据上推理容易混淆参照系与观测角度。问题是能否通过可调用的3D视角工具主动选择证据，以及训练出的选择是否优于随机或固定视角。
analysis.methodZh: Pi3先从输入multi-view/video重建colored pointcloud/cameras；VLM选择camera anchor、global/ego mode与rotation，renderer将视角结果回馈history，循环observe–manipulate–reflect。Think3D-RL离线缓存每训练scene的pointcloud、在线render选定角度，以terminal answer+format rewards训练GRPO，只对生成action/answer tokens优化。v5补充policy controls与action/prompt细节，澄清gain来源。
methodFlow: 用Pi3从输入multi-view images估计coloredpointcloud与camera poses；训练时预先缓存geometry。
VLM根据问题与已有observations选择anchor camera、viewmode及rotation；global旋转scene、ego旋转camera并筛view cone。
point-based renderer返回观测并追加history，最多三轮、可提前回答。
GRPO用terminal answer与format reward训练exploration，冻结visionencoder并屏蔽observationtoken梯度；训练angles限制为八候选。
analysis.experimentsZh: MindCube训练977scene examples，Qwen3VL4B fullLMfinetune/visionfrozen，GRPO8rollouts、1epoch/8H200、batch8×4accum、1e-6、KL.05、response1024、train/evaltemp.6/1。BLINKMV、MindCube1K、VSI-Tiny7frames；proprietary最多两轮、Qwen三轮；每setting评测三次取平均。 以下结果为作者报告：作者按3:1:2重算MindCube，Gemini40.05→60.25(+20.20pp)、GPT4.1 47.58→55.25(+7.67pp)；GCA64.17仍高于Think3D Gemini60.25。（v5 Table1 p.9; v4 Table1 p.5）；作者新增sameRLbackbone random45.11 vslearned53.39，Heuristic originalbackbone47.37；支持有效observation选择。（v5 Table5 p.12）；作者报告VSI Qwentrained33.36→45.41(+12.05pp)，但originalraw38.28，因此不能将+12.05当相对originalnetgain。（v5 Table2 p.9） 对照范围：spatialspecialists、PySpatial/GCA/Tiger、raw/standardGRPO、cameraanchor/choice/ego sequential组件，以及sameRLbackbone randomcontrol；不同闭源模型预算和specialists训练不完全matched，geometrytool/runtime cost未形成统一总预算benchmark。 消融与诊断：newviewpointcontrols比anglehistogram更有因果信息；componenttable原v4已存在，v5修正rec-alone『drop』文字为实际提升。未系统测Pi3geometry质量/遮挡、错camera估计和任意场景；singlecheckpointreward/turnscurve不是通用RL机制证明。
analysis.insightZh: 精确archived v4为10页，v5为32页；核心Pi3/toolloop/GRPO和主要分项结果已有。实质delta包括Table5的random/heuristic/RLrandom/learnedpolicy控制（45.86/47.37/45.11/53.39）、Table1按Among:Rotation:Around=3:1:2纠正overall（例如Gemini47.00/59.97改40.05/60.25，gain12.97改20.20），以及公开训练八候选角度和完整stageprompts，撤去continuous-angle泛化说法。新增控制及修正比较影响科学解释，值得更新现有canonical，不能作为新算法或新一次mainexperiment包装。
analysis.evidenceZh: v5 corrected weighted overall与新增viewpointcontrol是真实science delta，核心method未变。（v4 Table1 p.5; v5 Tables1/5 pp.9/12, App.A p.18; archived v4/v5 PDFs）；cameraanchored几何操纵和renderedobservations支持agent的多轮空间判断。（v5 §§3.1–3.4 pp.3–6, Figure2 p.4, Eq.3–9）；作者报告RLrandom45.11% vslearned53.39%，相同RLbackbone/三轮控制支持viewselection作用。（v5 §5.5, Table5 p.12）；作者报告Qwen rawMindCube29.83，untunedtool27.33；RLwithouttool30.00、withtool33.58。（v5 Table1 p.9）；作者报告VSI trainedwithouttool33.36降于original38.28，withtool45.41；BLINKtrained46.11→53.39。（v5 Table2 p.9）；RL八候选angle、outcome+formatreward、无中间view监督。（v5 §3.4 p.6, Table3 p.10, App.A/B pp.18–26）
analysis.caveatZh: 八候选actions、有限迭代及建议topview等prompt先验约束exploration，不支持任意连续3D控制已自主学会。；render依赖Pi3estimatedgeometry/cameras，不补足不可见geometry；activeinspection可启发设计评审，但未在LEGO/CAD/fabrication任务验证。；RLwithouttools在部分benchmark下降，toolgain与裸模型能力不同；三次evaluationmean没有独立trainingseeds/CI。；appendixFigure20的printedquestion与window/clock/trashbin推理不匹配，不能把全部qualitative traces当严密一致的额外证据。；代码范围：v5 PDF p.1 CodeModelsData annotation指向官方repo，HTTP200含spagent/train/plugin/scripts及run_eval.sh/test.py；源证明保存，未执行训练或主benchmark。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 明确3Dgeometry操作接口与learnedviewselection直接关联VLM空间推理，能启发对结构化3Dartifact主动检查的agent；这属于方法迁移判断，本文未测试设计artifact生成或制造可行性。
